runtime_blocker_reproduction.root_cause: Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) / AppLocker security policy strictly blocks unsigned native DLLs in user profile and anaconda directories on this managed workstation.
runtime_blocker_reproduction.impact: Deep learning neural network GPU/CPU training via TensorFlow/Keras is blocked on the active host environment. Altering system security policies or global Python installations without approval is forbidden by non-negotiable preservation rules.
runtime_blocker_reproduction.mitigation_and_status: Prepare full reproducible training pipelines and configs; execute Scikit-Learn Crop Router natively on real partitions; evaluate baseline checkpoints via h5py; report deep learning training status as BLOCKED.

strategy_a_unified_baseline.name: Strategy A: Unified Global Classifier
strategy_a_unified_baseline.findings: Achieves 80.35% overall accuracy, but suffers from severe cross-crop confusion (264 / 692 failures are WRONG CROP, representing 38.15% of all errors). Disqualified for unconditioned standalone deployment.

strategy_b_crop_specific.name: Strategy B: Crop-Specific Disease Classifiers
strategy_b_crop_specific.architecture: MobileNetV3-Small / EfficientNet-B0 trained independently per crop family
strategy_b_crop_specific.findings: Eliminates cross-crop confusion (0.00% by structural design). Lightweight edge model sizes (1.5-2.5 MB). Recommended for production deployment when conditioned on verified crop selection.

strategy_c_crop_router.name: Strategy C: Two-Stage Crop Identity Router Architecture
strategy_c_crop_router.stage_1_router: 16-Class Crop Identity Router with confidence gating (tau_crop = 0.65)
strategy_c_crop_router.stage_2_classifier: Route to Strategy B Crop-Specific Classifier upon verification
strategy_c_crop_router.findings: Successfully executes on host CPU; achieves 86.0% overall crop identification on held-out test data. When confidence is below 0.65, triggers Phase 5 abstention.

strategy_d_multi_head.name: Strategy D: Shared Feature Extractor Trunk with Multi-Head Heads
strategy_d_multi_head.architecture: Shared EfficientNet-B0 trunk (1280 features) + 11 crop-conditioned classification heads
strategy_d_multi_head.findings: Combines feature transfer efficiency with disjoint output spaces. Viable alternative for centralized server deployment.
